title: 第9章 炎城第10章 大比开始
lines: 地老悄悄在孩童袖中塞入九宫阵盘，人老则把缩小后的焚天塔挂在他颈间。
三位老者谁都没说破，这些法器里都藏着他们百年修为凝聚的保命禁制。
淬火池突然沸腾，池水映出林战焦急的身影。
当父亲的手穿过禁制屏障时，林烬突然回头看向三老。
十岁少年眼中银火流转，竟与当年天老在星图上看到的炎尊虚影完美重叠。
“大爷爷、二爷爷、三爷爷再见了，
我很快就会回来的，你们可不能够偷偷溜出去玩儿哦，
不然烬儿到时候回来又找不到你们了！”
十岁的林烬此时身高接近一米六了，算不上高，也算不上矮。
一头银色长发高高束起，剑眉星目，颇为英俊。
天地人三老闻言也皆是看向林烬点了点头，
心中说不出的感觉，
十年时间，他们三人早已经将林烬当作了自己的亲孙子对待，
将自己所学尽数教授给了林烬。
此时，见到林烬即将离开，心中自然十分不舍。
但同时，三人也是有些欣喜，因为这十年时间里林烬可是时常让他们头疼不已，
因为林烬始终不能够完美的控制九狱炎骨的力量，
并且，林烬也时常做出一些让天地人三老疑惑和震惊的事情！
这一度成为了三人的噩梦，纷纷将林烬看做小怪物一般！
不过三人在这些年当中也能够看出来，林烬的那些怪异行为也逐渐减少，
直到最近一年里几乎没有再发生过！
似乎林烬已经完全恢复正常了一般！
此时，林战带着那跟随了林烬十年的十数位亲卫，
朝着天地人三老深深鞠了一躬之后，带着林烬快速离去！
而此时的林烬修为已经达到了淬体境九重，
不过，天地人三老为了保护林烬，刻意将林烬的修为压制到了淬体境九重。
其实，这五年时间里，
林烬的大多数时间都在学习实践天地人三老教授的炼丹、布阵以及炼器之术，
否则林烬此时恐怕早已经步入到了灵泉境了！
数日之后，林烬等人终于回到了林家，而此时，
林家所有在闲之人纷纷来到了广场之上等待着林烬的回归！
“他就是林烬少爷吗？长的可真是英俊潇洒！”
“是啊，而且我能够感觉到他十分强大，总有一股若有若无的压迫感传来！”
“咦，你也能够感觉到吗？我还以为只有我才有这种感觉呢！”
此时，看到林战身后的林烬时，众人议论纷纷！
而林烬此时却略显娇羞与尴尬，因为他自小就没有见到过如此多人。
content_en:
The old man quietly stuffed the Nine Palace Formation Disk into the child's sleeve, while the old man hung the shrunken Burning Sky Tower around his neck.
None of the three old men revealed that these magical artifacts contained life-saving restrictions that they had accumulated over hundreds of years of cultivation.
The quenching pool suddenly boiled, and Lin Zhan's anxious figure was reflected in the water.
When his father's hand passed through the forbidden barrier, Lin Jin suddenly turned back to look at the three elders.
The silver fire flowing in the ten-year-old boy's eyes actually perfectly overlapped with the shadow of Yan Zun that Tian Lao saw on the star map.
"Goodbye, eldest grandpa, second grandpa, and third grandpa,
I'll be back soon. You can't sneak out to play.
Otherwise, Jin'er won't be able to find you when he comes back! "
Ten-year-old Lin Jin is now close to 1.6 meters tall, neither tall nor short.
He has long silver hair tied up high, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, and is quite handsome.
Hearing this, the three elders of Heaven and Earth all looked at Lin Jin and nodded.
The indescribable feeling in my heart,
In ten years, the three of them had already treated Lin Jin as their own grandson.
He taught Lin Jin everything he had learned.
At this time, seeing that Lin Jin was about to leave, he felt very sad.
But at the same time, the three of them were also a little happy, because Lin Jin had often given them headaches in the past ten years.
Because Lin Jin has never been able to perfectly control the power of the Nine Hell Flame Bones,
Moreover, Lin Jin often did things that puzzled and shocked everyone in the world!
This became a nightmare for the three of them, and they all regarded Lin Jin as a little monster!
However, the three of them could also see that Lin Jin's weird behaviors gradually decreased over the years.
It almost never happened again in the past year!
It seems that Lin Jin has completely returned to normal!
At this time, Lin Zhan took the dozen personal guards who had followed Lin Jin for ten years,
After bowing deeply to the three elders of Heaven, Earth, Man, and others, he took Lin Jin and left quickly!
At this time, Lin Jin's cultivation had reached the ninth level of the body tempering realm.
However, in order to protect Lin Jin, the three elders of Heaven, Earth, Man and Man deliberately suppressed Lin Jin's cultivation level to the ninth level of the body tempering realm.
In fact, during these five years,
Lin Jin spent most of his time learning and practicing the techniques of alchemy, formation formation, and weapon refining taught by the three elders of Heaven, Earth, and People.
Otherwise, Lin Jin might have already entered the spiritual spring realm by now!
A few days later, Lin Jin and others finally returned to the Lin family. At this time,
All the idle people of the Lin family came to the square and waited for Lin Jin's return!
"Is he Young Master Lin Jin? He is so handsome and handsome!"
"Yes, and I can feel that he is very powerful, and there is always a vague sense of oppression coming from him!"
"Hey, can you feel it too? I thought I was the only one who felt this way!"
…
At this time, when they saw Lin Jin behind Lin Zhan, everyone started talking!
Lin Jin felt a little shy and embarrassed at this time, because he had never seen so many people since he was a child.
